text:
Amanda W: quick check before tomorrow's private deploy — do we have final signoff on the TLS policy + who owns KMS keys for customer A? deploy window 10:00am PT.
Devon K: we pushed the certs to the LB staging yesterday. LB does TLS termination for hosted, but for Private Customer A they asked for customer-managed keys in their VPC KMS.
Marco T: correct — for Private we expect customer KMS (BYOK). infra created the role for vault-to-kms access. need confirm on rotation cadence.
Leah S: security preference: TLSv1.3 only for new connections, allow TLS1.2 fallback for older clients if strictly required. KMS CMKs should have automatic rotation enabled + audit log retention 1y.
security-bot: reminder: per policy (sec#KMS-007) customer CMKs must have key policy listing redwood-infra-role and a dedicated audit account. See https://go/redwood/sec/kms-guidelines 
Amanda W: is that audit account in place for Customer A? and who will do the key rotation on day 0 if customer doesn't enable it?
Marco T: audit account exists, InfraOncall has read-only access. If customer doesn't enable rotation we can enable automatic rotation on our side only for hosted keys — for BYOK we need their action. we should send the checklist to the customer now.
Devon K: tiny config note for LB: nginx has `ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;` — can flip to `TLSv1.3` only but need to watch traffic. quick curl test:```curl --tlsv1.3 -I https://private.customer-a.redwood.internal``` returned 200 on staging.
Amanda W: perfect. what about logs — ensure we don't store full cert chains or raw client hello in plaintext.
security-bot: policy: redact `x-forwarded-client-cert` and client cert PEMs in logs. Keep JA3 fingerprints only if customer opts in and consent recorded.
sre-bot: added a logging rule to the staging cluster: `log_filter: redact_fields: ["client_cert", "tls_client_hello"]` — rolling now.
InfraOncall: I'm on standby at 09:30 PT to support cert rollover. If any access approvals needed ping me.
Leah S: approving rotation plan for staging -> prod as long as rotation owners are listed in the ticket and audit logging enabled. :thumbsup:
Devon K: tagging ticket sec-req-428 with owners: Marco (infra), Leah (security), Amanda (release).
Amanda W: thanks — I'll post the customer checklist and confirm with them we need BYOK enabled before 09:00 PT. if not, we'll postpone the private deploy by 24h. :pray:
Marco T: noted. I'll also add an OpenSSL check to the runbook:`openssl s_client -connect private.customer-a.redwood.internal:443 -tls1_3 -showcerts`
Amanda W: great. leaving this thread open until we have customer confirmation.
Leah S: once customer confirms, I'll close the loop and update sec-req-428 with final approvals.
security-bot: action items created: sec-req-428 (KMS ownership), log-redact-193 (logging filters).
Amanda W: :white_check_mark: thanks everyone, will update here with customer reply.
